summary: Import thunk for the Winsock API WSACleanup. Forwarded through the import address table: reads the __imp_WSACleanup pointer at 0x0059E318 and tail-calls the imported zero-argument function, returning its int result unchanged.

operations.description: Tail-call the imported WSACleanup through the IAT pointer __imp_WSACleanup (global 0x0059E318, read); no arguments are passed.
Return the imported function's int result directly; the thunk adds no computation of its own.

unresolved: No callers are recorded in evidence, so the game-side call site that shuts down Winsock (and the pairing WSAStartup) is not in evidence here.
The __imp_WSACleanup IAT slot is resolved at load time against ws2_32.dll; the actual library implementation is outside this binary.
